ci-bot: CI perf check failed for PR #7481 (commit abc1234)
ci-bot: benchmark: runtime_micro/kv_cache_hitrate | baseline=87.2% new=80.3% diff=-6.9% (threshold -4%)
ci-bot: p50 latency for generate_tokens: baseline=15.0ms new=17.1ms diff=+14% (threshold +8%)

steph: FYI saw the CI failure just now. PR touches kernel-selector heuristics + a tiny change in batching warmup.
steph: anyone reproduce locally quickly?

omar: repro'd on my devbox (a100). ran the microbench harness with the same seed — kv hitrate dropped ~6% and p50 bumped ~12%.
omar: attaching the lightweight flame output I grabbed (truncated):

omar: ```
flame:
  runtime::kernel_selector::select_best_kernel  38%
  runtime::kv_cache::lookup_and_prefetch       14%
  runtime::batcher::maybe_warmup               10%
  runtime::dispatcher::enqueue                 8%
  other                                       30%
```

ashley: interesting — kernel_selector is taking more time, which could be starving prefetch paths? PR changed affinity heuristic to prefer single-threaded kernels for short sequences.
ashley: that might change ordering of requests hitting the KV prefetch window and reduce effective hit rate.

ryan: +1 on that hypothesis. If kernel selection delays first token, KV entries might be evicted before reuse. Did the PR also change KV eviction policy? I glanced at it — no, eviction unchanged.

steph: ok plan: bisect the PR stack. suspect commit range: (optimize-kernel-routing -> adjust-batcher-warmup). If bisect points at kernel_selector change, we can consider reverting that commit until we can address prefetch timing.

omar: I can run a narrow bisect across those two commits and report microbench numbers. Will run the same harness with `--kv-trace` to collect hit/evict events.

ashley: if you get kv trace, include key timestamps around first token generation. I want to see timeline: prefetch->evict->lookup.

ci-bot: Created perf alert ticket: PERF-1273 and linked PR #7481. Notified eng-runtime-oncall.

ryan: quick mitigation option: pin kernel selector to previous heuristic in Dedicated until we fix. But that requires a config rollout — can do if bisect confirms.

steph: assign to @omar for bisect, @ashley for trace analysis. If we confirm, we'll either revert kernel change or add a micro-batcher warmup to preserve prefetch window.

omar: starting bisect now, will post results in this thread. ETA ~30m.

steph: thanks — also add the failing CI artifact link: https://ci.redwood/archives/7481/perf-report.html

omar: bisect update: commit abc1234 (kernel-selector affinity change) -> diff shows kv hitrate drop. Running a micro run with selector pinned to old heuristic shows hitrate back to 87%.

ashley: confirmed from trace: with new heuristic prefetch is delayed ~8ms on short sequences causing ~3 eviction windows to miss. That's the root cause.

steph: agreement: revert kernel-selector affinity change in PR while we design an approach that keeps prefetch timing invariant. I'll open a revert PR and tag for expedited deploy.

ryan: created revert PR #7492. Marking as rollback-blocker for today's deploy window.

ci-bot: NOTE: rolling revert candidate #7492 to staging for smoke perf runs.

steph: good work team. After revert, let's add a unit test that emulates KV prefetch timing + short sequences so this doesn't regress again.
